modules.title: 一个周末原型怎样在“说、跑、看”之间成形
快速试做怎样变成可观察的下一轮

items.title: 先说出眼前想要的效果
items.text: 用户描述一个小功能，AI 直接生成或修改代码；重点是尽快得到能运行、能看见的版本。

items.title: 再用结果推动修改
items.text: 用户运行项目，把画面、报错和手感当作反馈，再说“按钮太挤”或贴回错误信息，让 AI 继续调整。

items.title: 用途变严肃就切换做法
items.text: 原型一旦要保存真实数据、处理账号权限或长期维护，就要读懂关键改动，补测试并检查依赖、错误处理和安全边界。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Vibe Coding 不等于所有 AI 辅助编程。认真阅读差异、理解代码并验证结果，也是在用 AI 写代码，却不一定属于原始语境中“很少看代码、一路接受修改”的 Vibe Coding；原型跑通更不等于可以直接上线。

lessonPractice.title: AI 做出的活动报名页已经能在本机打开，团队准备明天收集真实姓名和手机号。下一步更合适的是？

options.label: 暂停继续堆功能，先检查数据流、权限和依赖，补关键测试并由人审查改动
options.feedback: 对。本机画面正常只证明原型能运行；接触真实个人信息前，需要把它当正式软件检查和验证。

options.label: 继续接受 AI 的全部修改，只要页面没有报错就直接上线
options.feedback: 没有报错不能证明数据处理、权限和异常路径安全，真实信息不适合只靠原型体验验收。

options.label: 先让 AI 把颜色和动画做精致，视觉完成后再默认功能可靠
options.feedback: 视觉完成度与数据是否正确保存、是否越权没有直接关系，不能代替技术检查。

en.title: An AI-built event signup page works locally, and the team plans to collect real names and phone numbers tomorrow. What is the better next step?

options.label: Pause feature work, inspect data flow, permissions, and dependencies, add critical tests, and have a person review the changes
options.feedback: Correct. A working local screen proves only that the prototype runs. Software handling real personal data needs formal review and verification.

options.label: Keep accepting every AI change and ship as soon as the page shows no error
options.feedback: No visible error does not establish safe data handling, authorization, or failure behavior.

options.label: Polish colors and animation first, then treat visual completion as proof that the feature is reliable
options.feedback: Visual polish says nothing about correct storage or access control and cannot replace technical checks.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 我想先用 Vibe Coding 做一个周末原型，只放假数据，不接账号、支付或真实用户信息。请先做能运行的最小版本，每次改动后都运行项目并检查实际效果；如果需要真实数据、密钥或不可逆操作，先停下来告诉我。完成后列出上线前仍要审查和测试的部分。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: I want to vibe-code a weekend prototype using fake data only, with no accounts, payments, or real user information. Build the smallest runnable version first, then run the project and check the actual result after every change. Stop and tell me before using real data, secrets, or irreversible actions. When it works, list what still needs review and testing before release.

learning.assumes: You have asked an AI assistant to change a page or write code.
learning.outcome: You can describe a scoped change, ask for evidence, and verify the result instead of treating generated code as automatically correct.

modules.title: Turn a visible page problem into an agent task you can check
How to direct and verify AI-assisted building

items.title: Describe the observable result
items.text: State what should change, what must stay untouched, and where the problem appears.

items.title: Give the agent usable context
items.text: Provide the relevant files, constraints, and test result instead of asking it to guess.

items.title: Verify the delivered work
items.text: Review the changed files and test the requested behavior at the needed screen sizes.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Vibe coding is a way of collaborating with an AI agent, not a substitute for product decisions, security checks, or real testing.
